mapper.insert: insert into defense_topics (teacher_id, topic_name, topic_description, defense_time, created_at, updated_at) values (#{teacherId}, #{topicName}, #{topicDescription}, #{defenseTime}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

insert into defense_questions (topic_id, teacher_id, question_type, question, standard_answer,created_at, updated_at) values (#{topicId}, #{teacherId}, #{questionType}, #{question}, #{standardAnswer}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT question_id AS questionId, topic_id AS topicId, teacher_id AS teacherId, question_type AS questionType, question, standard_answer AS standardAnswer, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM defense_questions WHERE topic_id = #{topicId} AND question_type = 'teacher' ORDER BY question_id ASC
select topic_name as topicName, topic_description as topicDescription from defense_topics where topic_id = #{topicId}
select teacher_id from defense_topics where topic_id = #{topicId}

SELECT question_id AS questionId, topic_id AS topicId, teacher_id AS teacherId, question_type AS questionType, question, standard_answer AS standardAnswer, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM defense_questions WHERE topic_id = #{topicId} AND question_type = 'teacher' ORDER BY question_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM defense_answers WHERE question_id = #{questionId}
